title: A shorter changelog
summary: The Changelog opens on the two newest releases; older ones fold to one line each, with a list to jump to any version.
items: The two newest releases (and the latest Android download) are shown in full.
Older releases show their date and summary line; open one to read every change.
"Jump to an Android version" and a dated list of website releases open the release you pick, and links to a release still work.
